presentation.name: Draft dashboard pages, charts and KPIs from a dataset
presentation.summary: Drafts pages, chart types and KPIs from a dataset already in hand, each one tied to fields, grain and a quality caveat.
benefits: Names the source fields, the grain and the quality caveat on every proposed metric
Drops a column marked unsafe, or keeps it with the caveat in the same line
Separates a KPI from a breakdown, and treats a visual that mixes grains as a finding
Stays a short, assumed list when the audience or the decision is not known
